findings.evidence: Lines 383–385 prove the graph-specific coercion equality without an attribute; lines 400–408 mark only `coe_graph` as simp and leave `toMeasure_graph` untagged, while `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/ProbabilityMeasure.lean:631` marks the generic `ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map` lemma `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Mark `toMeasure_map_prodMk_self` (or an equivalently oriented `toMeasure_graph`) `@[simp]` so coercions of bundled graph plans normalize to `graphPlan` without explicit rewrites.
findings.issue: `toMeasure_map_prodMk_self` is a characteristic normalization lemma but lacks `@[simp]`; consequently simplifying `((Coupling.graph hT : ProbabilityMeasure _) : Measure _)` follows `coe_graph` and Mathlib's simp-tagged `ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map` to a raw `Measure.map`, rather than the canonical `graphPlan`.

summary: The new bundled graph-plan coercion API lacks the normal-form simp rule needed to recover `graphPlan`.
